socialist-republic-of-vietnam used 4 pages (3 opened for its own events plus the PRK page cited as a second page) against a 1-2 page budget, because its only border moves are the Cambodian war and the 1979 Chinese invasion; 6 distinct pages were opened in all (sources_total 8 counts per-dossier lists).

The Vietnamese presence in Cambodia 1979-1989 is recorded as hatched occupation in both the socialist-republic-of-vietnam and people-s-republic-of-kampuchea dossiers; a client-state (vassal tint) reading is the alternative.

Matching events are needed in other groups' dossiers: people-s-republic-of-china (Feb-Mar 1979 contest, 1999 gain), khmer-rouge (1977-79 contests with socialist-republic-of-vietnam), kingdom-of-cambodia already has the 1993 gain from the PRK (its whole-country region includes the Pailin province the PRK dossier loses in 1989).
